comparison.objective: Reconnect a basin stopper pivot rod through the stopper eye so the lever operates the retained cap.
comparison.physical_skill: Occluded alignment and insertion of a rod through a small eye, followed by mechanism actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Rod engagement plus a complete released opening-and-reseating cycle.
comparison.reason: It shares functional post-assembly cycling, but tests captive linkage insertion rather than adjustable damping, lock retention, and bounded dynamic stopping.
